## Description

Triage infrastructure only; no WPF runtime changes.

Issues.Title: [dnceng-bot] Branch `wpf/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch
Issues.Body:
Branch [release/8.0](https://github.com/dotnet/wpf/commits/release/8.0/) in `dotnet/wpf` repo can't be mirrored from GitHub to Azure [internal/release/8.0](https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/internal/_git/dotnet-wpf?version=GBinternal%2Frelease%2F8.0&_a=history) via internal merge. 

There are conflicting commits in the target branch.
The branch is configured to be mirrored via automated merge. 
The situation is rare but normal. The target branch is expected to receive manual commits in the Azure DevOps clone, which could cause conflict.

Conflicts need to be **resolved to unblock the code flow**.

- you can resolve the issue by resolving the conflict in the **target branch only**. 
    - Please make sure that the changes sensitive from security perspective are not published ahead of time to GitHub!
- reverting the extra commits in the Azdo target branch.
- checking the logs of the mirroring process in the [mirroring pipeline](https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/internal/_build?definitionId=1387).
- you can disable the mirroring of the branch in the [configuration file](https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/internal/_git/dotnet-mirroring?path=/dnceng-subscriptions.jsonc).
- you can ask @dotnet/dnceng for help or read the [documentation](https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/internal/_git/dotnet-mirroring?path=/README.md).

Please close this issue once the conflict is resolved.

Issues.Title: System.IO.FileFormatException when printing documents containing Calibri family fonts in .NET 11
Issues.Body:
### Description

We are encountering a printing issue in .NET 11 when printing documents that contain specific font families. 

During the print operation, the following exception is thrown:
_System.IO.FileFormatException: File 'file:///C:/WINDOWS/FONTS/CALIBRI.TTF' has an invalid file format._

The exception occurs during the following call:
_printDialog.PrintDocument(documentPaginator, printDescription);_

This issue is reproducible only in .NET 11 and does not occur in .NET 10 when using the same application and printing logic. We verified the behavior on multiple machines and were able
to reproduce the issue consistently.

The following font families are known to trigger the exception:

- Calibri
- Cambria
- Cambria Math
- Constantia
- Corbel



### Reproduction Steps

1.	Run the attached sample application.
2.	Click the "Print" button.
3.	The Print dialog will open. Print the document as PDF.
4.	A System.IO.FileFormatException is thrown.
5.	Please refer to the attached video for a detailed illustration of the issue.

[Print issues - NET11-Application.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34181257/Print.issues.-.NET11-Application.zip)

[NET11 Print issue - Video.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34181265/NET11.Print.issue.-.Video.zip)

### Expected behavior

Documents containing the above font families should print successfully without throwing any exceptions.

### Actual behavior

The print operation fails with a `System.IO.FileFormatException`, indicating that the font file has an invalid file format.

### Regression?

Yes. Working fine in .NET 10
Break in .NET 11

### Known Workarounds

_No response_

### Impact

_No response_

### Configuration

.NET 11
Windows
WPF sample

### Other information
